Application Data.NAME: Serenity Skincare Boutique
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Serenity Skincare Boutique specializes in the retail of high-quality skincare and cosmetic products, offering a curated selection of both established and emerging brands. Our operations include an in-store retail experience complemented by a secure e-commerce platform for online orders. We prioritize product safety and customer satisfaction by implementing stringent inventory control measures and ensuring all products are compliant with relevant regulations and ingredient testing standards. Our team is dedicated to promoting safe and effective skincare solutions while maintaining transparent marketing practices that accurately represent the benefits of our products.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a customer reported a skin irritation reaction after using one of our facial serums, resulting in a claim of $1,250.00. The issue was resolved amicably, with the claim closed on 04/10/2023. The product was removed from our inventory pending further investigation, but no contamination was found, and the product was reinstated after a safety review.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1, UL Listed Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system monitored 24/7 with trained security personnel during business hours.
